title: Identifying Topological Differences in Two Populations of Random Geometric Objects
summary: We propose a statistical framework to identify topological differences in two populations of random geometric objects. The proposed framework involves first associating a topological signature with random geometric objects and then performing a two-sample test using the observed topological signatures. We associate persistence barcodes, a topological signature from topological data analysis, with each observed random geometric object.
